name: pitmaster
description: Skills for running work with Claude: grill the plan before it starts (bbq), record decisions as ADRs (makeadr), find what is holding a run back (swarm-bottleneck), pick its budget (budget-select) and models (tier-select), record what it spent beside what it landed (spend-ledger), let the agent pick the work (dealers-choice) and give it standing authority for a session (carte-blanche), set a project up for agents (project-prep), talk a subject through, then write one record of what was said (talk-through), audit blind whether a repo or an app is ready for its end users (tastetest), and carry a settled plan on into the build, stopping at "ratify" (goforit).

interface.shortDescription: Grill the plan, record the decision, find the bottleneck, pick the budget and the models.
